title: Cloud Service Provider Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of each of the organization's authorized Cloud Service Providers (CSPs).

title: Cloud Service Provider Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of each service authorized for use in each authorized Cloud Service Provider (CSP).

title: Cloud Service Provider Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of the organization's authorized Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) providers.

title: Cloud Service Provider Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of the accounts authorized for use in each authorized Cloud Service Provider (CSP) or Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) provider.

title: Cloud Service Provider Management Policy
definition: Maintain a cybersecurity configuration benchmark for each of the organization's authorized Cloud Service Providers (CSPs).

title: Cloud Service Provider Management Policy
definition: Maintain a cybersecurity configuration benchmark for each service authorized for use in each of the organization's authorized Cloud Service Providers (CSPs).

title: Cloud Service Provider Management Policy
definition: Maintain a cybersecurity configuration benchmark for each of the organization's authorized Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) providers.

title: Cloud Service Provider Management Policy
definition: Maintain a cloud configuration vulnerability management system to regularly scan each of the organization's authorized Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) or Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) providers for potential cybersecurity vulnerabilities.

title: Cloud Service Provider Management Policy
definition: Maintain a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) system to regularly log and alert on potential data loss events in the organization's Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) or Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) providers.

title: Cloud Service Provider Management Policy
definition: Ensure that appropriate logs from the organization's authorized Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) or Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) providers are enabled on the cloud platform.

title: Cloud Service Provider Management Policy
definition: Ensure that appropriate logs from the organization's authorized Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) or Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) providers are aggregated into the organization's log management system.
